description: Operator-gated, confirm-gated A3 backfill that converges every live export source (chatgpt_export, claude_ai_export) onto a single content-addressed blob keyed by session-ledger-export-sha256-<digest> and reclaims the now-unreferenced blobs. confirm=False is a READ-ONLY dry run that computes counts only (mutates nothing) and returns {confirmed: false, sources_scanned, blobs_needing_key, sources_needing_repoint, orphan_blobs_candidate}. confirm=True runs Phase 0 (durable kind-tag every referenced blob BEFORE any pointer moves) -> Phase 1 (per source: hash -> content-digest external_id -> find + byte-verify the content twin -> repoint the source's root_uri onto it) -> Phase 2 (sweep the orphaned export blobs) and returns {confirmed: true, sources_scanned, blobs_keyed, sources_repointed, export_blobs_deleted, skipped, error_count}. Forward-only, convergent and idempotent: re-running re-converges; a crash between a repoint-commit and the orphan delete is healed by the next run's Phase-2 sweep. Fail-fast: any per-source / per-blob failure raises BackfillError. SEQUENCING GUARDRAIL -- do NOT run standalone: the Phase-1 repoint deliberately makes a duplicate source's root_uri collide with its content-twin on (source_kind, root_uri); that collision is the INTENDED precondition for source-row dedup, so a confirmed run MUST be followed by the source-row collapse step (repair_duplicate_sources / the Deploy-3 (source_kind, root_uri) unique index + ON-CONFLICT). In the pre-collapse window the M18 (vendor, external_session_id) canonical index prevents permanent session duplication. Requires an operator / operator-equivalent principal (assert_operator_principal) -- a missing CallContext is a denial.
embedding_description: Operator-gated, confirm-gated export-blob content-digest identity backfill (A3). Converges duplicate chatgpt_export / claude_ai_export blobs onto one session-ledger-export-sha256-<digest> blob and sweeps the orphans. confirm=false dry-run returns counts (blobs_needing_key, sources_needing_repoint, orphan_blobs_candidate); confirm=true runs tag -> key -> twin-verify -> repoint -> orphan-sweep and returns blobs_keyed, sources_repointed, export_blobs_deleted, skipped, error_count. Forward-only, convergent, idempotent, fail-fast (BackfillError). Operator-principal required.
